name: Billing Method 1
definition: Provides the details for the tax calculation method A.

ServiceChargeHostAmount.name: Service Charge Host Amount
ServiceChargeHostAmount.definition: Amount of the original charge expressed in the host currency.

ServiceTax.name: Service Tax
ServiceTax.definition: Provides for the regional taxes on the service. Up to three regional taxes may be defined for the same service.

TotalCharge.name: Total Charge
TotalCharge.definition: Specifies the total charge for a service (including taxes).

TaxIdentification.name: Tax Identification
TaxIdentification.definition: Provides for the specific tax identification within the same tax region. ||Usage: This element allows for a maximum of three regional taxes on the same service.
